rationale: Apply P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads). The workflow runs four jobs, and each Python job (quality, tests, docs) reinstalls dependencies via PDM/nox from pyproject.toml on every run with no dependency cache, so dependency fetching is repeated. The pattern preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and pyproject.toml exists as a cache input; no equivalent cache is present and the cached content is immutable dependency downloads, so no contraindication applies. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') with restore-keys mirrors the measured Python/pyproject.toml experiment and only caches downloads—every lint, typecheck, test, docs, and security step still runs unchanged, so build/test coverage is preserved. The security job is left untouched because it does not install Python dependencies.
